system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:22, ivy.chen's medium-integrity cmd.exe ran a recursive listing of \\fileserv\shared$ and created a temporary file before exiting.

Google Drive File Stream started under ivy.chen, and Edge accessed drive.google.com, including the user's Drive and shared-with-me pages. Google Drive is not among the services listed as approved in the supplied environment context.
At 13:44, the proxy recorded a successful request for https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nwd-it/tools/main/u.ps1 from WS-ICHEN-01.
At 13:46, WS-ICHEN-01 established an SMB connection to DC-NWD-01; the associated network logon identifies the WS-ICHEN-01 computer account.
The unapproved Google Drive activity, script request, and SMB connection are concerning together, but the available records do not establish what data was transferred or what the script did.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection for WS-ICHEN-01 was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC due to a collection outage, overlapping the reported PowerShell appearance and the script request and SMB activity.
The supplied proxy and connection records show destinations and connection metadata, but do not establish the contents or purpose of transferred files.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell actually ran on WS-ICHEN-01 around 13:40, what command or script it executed, or which process initiated the 13:44 request.
Whether u.ps1 is legitimate, malicious, or related to the reported PowerShell window.
Whether files were uploaded to Google Drive or any other external service.
What SMB share, files, or operations were involved in the connection to DC-NWD-01, and whether it represented administrative activity.
Whether the observed activity was authorized by the organization or initiated by ivy.chen.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or verify WS-ICHEN-01 Sysmon and Winsec logs for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including process creation, command lines, script-block logging, and PowerShell operational logs.
Retrieve and analyze the content and provenance of the requested u.ps1, and determine whether it was saved or executed on WS-ICHEN-01.
Obtain proxy or cloud audit records showing Google Drive uploads, file names, sizes, and account activity during the review period.
Review SMB server-side logs on DC-NWD-01 to identify the share and operations associated with the 13:46 connection.
Validate with ivy.chen and IT whether the script request, Google Drive use, and connection to the domain controller were authorized.
